title: ADR-0018 D4: more direction from handoff (next-action in hf resume + packet)
objective: ADR-0018 D4: `hf resume` + the rendered packet emit EXPLICIT next-action direction — the single next safe task, the exact next command, the cycle/context-budget state, and the blocking walls — so a fresh agent needs zero archaeology. The handoff-loop skill gives richer steering (decision rationale + 'do this next', not just 'here is state').
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0018 D4: more direction from handoff (next-action in hf resume + packet): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
